verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill pack that runs sequential app-cloning stages (recon, design, build, test, parity, rebrand, launch). Nothing in the evidence documents a general capability to select and act on many items at once. The rebrand sweep that scans the whole codebase for the original's name is a specific single-purpose check, not a bulk-operations feature, so it earns no credit here.
